fact: The party enters Duergar territory near Gracklstugh, which is described as having "nobody but Duergar."
source_quote: The party travels on its permit into Duergar territory, where there is "nobody but Duergar."
subject: Gracklstugh

fact: The Duergar prefer each people to keep to its own place and value rule-following and directness.
source_quote: The Duergar prefer each people to keep to its own place, value rule-following and directness
subject: Duergar

fact: The Duergar are described as lacking a sense of humor and finding other species confusing.
source_quote: "lack a sense of humor," and find other species confusing.
subject: Duergar

fact: The party is led to a stone building near a massive cavern entrance where the ground trembles.
source_quote: The party is led by Duergar priests to a stone building near a massive cavern entrance, where the ground trembles
subject: Wyrmsmith's lair entrance

fact: A thunderous voice announces the arrival of Themberchaud.
source_quote: and a thunderous voice announces the arrival of Themberchaud.
subject: Themberchaud's arrival

fact: Themberchaud's first words upon arrival were, "You didn't say I was having surfacers for dinner tonight."
source_quote: "You didn't say I was having surfacers for dinner tonight."
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Themberchaud is a massive, overweight red dragon with lava-colored scales and glowing yellow eyes.
source_quote: Themberchaud, a massive and overweight red dragon with lava-colored scales and glowing yellow eyes
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Themberchaud is introduced as the Father of Flame and the Wyrmsmith of Gracklstugh.
source_quote: introduced as the Father of Flame and Wyrmsmith of Gracklstugh.
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Themberchaud dismisses the Duergar priests to speak with the party in private.
source_quote: Themberchaud dismissed the priests, who were visibly uncomfortable at leaving him alone with strangers
subject: Themberchaud dismisses priests

fact: Thorin suggests tipping the dragon off that the Duergar have "a new dragon in training."
source_quote: Thorin suggests tipping the dragon off that the Duergar have "a new dragon in training."
subject: Thorin's suggestion

fact: Gyrgum is a cleric of Bahamut.
source_quote: Gyrgum, as a cleric of Bahamut
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Inside his lair, Themberchaud breathes fire in all directions to ensure no invisible intruders are present.
source_quote: Themberchaud breathes fire in all directions to ensure no invisible intruders are present
subject: Themberchaud breathes fire

fact: Themberchaud thrashes his wings about in his lair.
source_quote: thrashed his wings about
subject: Themberchaud thrashes wings

fact: Themberchaud settles onto a mountain of gold in his lair.
source_quote: settling onto a mountain of gold
subject: Themberchaud settles

fact: Themberchaud warns that anyone invisible will be turned to ash.
source_quote: Anyone who's invisible will be turned to ash
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Themberchaud is described as looking like a zoo predator that gets fed every day.
source_quote: likens him to a zoo predator that "gets fed every day."
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Themberchaud dismisses Gyrgum's devotion to Bahamut with a curt "Next!"
source_quote: He dismissed Gyrgum's devotion to Bahamut with a curt "Next!"
subject: Themberchaud interrogates Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum states, "I serve Bahamut, the platinum dragon."
source_quote: Gyrgum: "I serve Bahamut, the platinum dragon."
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Themberchaud expresses mild disdain for Zalthir's brass dragonborn heritage.
source_quote: He expressed mild disdain for Zalthir's brass dragonborn heritage.
subject: Themberchaud interrogates Zalthir

fact: Themberchaud calls Zalthir "an inferior Dragonborn, if ever there was one."
source_quote: Themberchaud calls Zalthir "an inferior Dragonborn, if ever there was one."
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Themberchaud shows approval for Daz's Drow origins and capacity for secrecy.
source_quote: He showed a flicker of approval for Daz's Drow origins... and his capacity for secrecy.
subject: Themberchaud interrogates Daz

fact: Daz confirms he is from Menzoberranzan.
source_quote: Daz confirms he is from Menzoberranzan.
subject: Daz

fact: Themberchaud states, "At least they bring me someone who is capable of conspiracies and secrecy."
source_quote: Themberchaud: "At least they bring me someone who is capable of conspiracies and secrecy."
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Thorin states he is a foundling who grew up amongst giants and likes to hit things over the head.
source_quote: Thorin: "My name is Thorin Giantfriend, and I was a foundling and grew up amongst giants... but I like to hit things over the head."
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin explains he was simply minding his own business before waking up in a jail cell surrounded by Drow and strangers.
source_quote: When Thorin explained that he had simply been minding his own business before waking up in a jail cell surrounded by Drow and strangers
subject: Thorin

fact: Themberchaud seemed amused by Thorin's explanation of his circumstances.
source_quote: the dragon seemed almost amused.
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Themberchaud is delighted that the party has "nobody to be blackmailed."
source_quote: He was delighted that the party had "nobody to be blackmailed."
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Themberchaud declares the party his personal agents without waiting for their formal agreement.
source_quote: Without waiting for the party to formally agree, Themberchaud declared them his personal agents
subject: Themberchaud appoints agents

fact: Themberchaud states, "I want you to become my agents in Gracklstugh. And by being my agents, you will gain my protection."
source_quote: Themberchaud: "I want you to become my agents in Gracklstugh. And by being my agents, you will gain my protection."
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Themberchaud summons Gartokkar to act as the party's liaison.
source_quote: summoned his liaison Gartokkar
subject: Gartokkar

fact: Themberchaud presents each party member with a golden badge bearing his profile.
source_quote: presented each of them with a golden badge bearing his own profile
subject: Badge presentation

fact: The party members receive golden badges featuring Themberchaud's profile.
source_quote: presenting them with golden badges featuring the dragon's profile.
subject: Golden Badge

fact: Daz confirms the badge is real gold.
source_quote: Daz confirms the badge is real gold.
subject: Daz

fact: The party's first mission from Themberchaud is to do whatever the Keepers ask but report back to Themberchaud first.
source_quote: Their first mission is to do whatever the Keepers ask but report back to Themberchaud first.
subject: Themberchaud's mission

fact: The party reflects that they may already be "triple agents."
source_quote: The party reflects that they may already be "triple agents."
subject: Party allegiance

fact: Thorin suggests that the party needs to form its own faction.
source_quote: Thorin: "I think we need to form our own faction."
subject: Thorin
